# Bio-Kinetics Research & Development

> > Advanced 3D biomechanics analysis and baseball training using KineMetrics technology

Bio-Kinetics Research & Development (BKRD) specializes in baseball-specific training programs combining traditional coaching with cutting-edge 3D motion analysis technology. The facility offers private and group lessons, biomechanical assessments, and maintains a portfolio analyzing legendary players like Nolan Ryan and George Brett.

## Key Topics

- KineMetrics 3D motion analysis
- Baseball biomechanics
- Pitching mechanics
- Private baseball lessons
- Group training sessions
- Hall of Fame player analysis
- Nolan Ryan mechanics
- George Brett analysis
- 40-minute training sessions
- 30-minute training sessions
- Front-view pitching analysis
- Side-view pitching analysis
- Traditional vs modern training methods
- Lesson packages

- [40 MIN: 5 LESSON PACKAGE](https://biokinetics3d.com/product/40-min-5-lesson-package): 5-lesson package for 40-minute private baseball training sessions

- [40 MIN GROUP: 5 LESSON PACKAGE](https://biokinetics3d.com/product/40-min-group-5-lesson-package): 5-lesson package for 40-minute group baseball training sessions at BKRD
